spans.s: याचक m. ई f. petitioner, beggar.
याचन n. asking (also in marriage), begging for (—˚).
याचनीय a. to be asked or requested (n. imp.).
याचितव्य a. to be asked (also for a girl).

याचिष्णु a. asking, soliciting, suppliant;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

याच्ञा॑ f. asking, begging for (—˚);
 petition, request.
